visible_example_label: 개념 설명용 가상 예시 · 실제 관측값/예측선 아님
source: Watson et al. 2011, Table 3, printed p93 / PDF p4
assumptions: 1.30 m/s is an assumed intercept at PWV 898 cm/s, not a reported model intercept.
898 cm/s is the reported overall mean but is chosen here as an illustrative reference; the original model centering constant is not established.
X is baseline PWV across differing levels, not within-person PWV change.
No observations, fitted participant trajectories or CI bands are fabricated.

visible_example_label: 개념 설명용 가상 예시 · 실제 관측값/예측선 아님
source: Watson et al. 2011, Table 3, printed p93 / PDF p4
assumptions: 1.30 m/s at t=0 is assumed and is not a reported model intercept.
The Time coefficient is conditional on PWV/covariate reference values, not the observed mean change for every PAD participant.
The line illustrates the Time coefficient and is not a reconstructed model prediction.
No observations, group mean trajectories or CI bands are fabricated.
